messages:
sam (eng-platform): Quick question — for enterprise customers, should we support per-route role bindings in the console, or keep roles only at the tenant level?
anya (product): Need both. Tenant roles as the default, with per-route overrides for cases like embedding-only teams. But UX must avoid confusing admins.
celine (design): Proposal: show effective role inline in the routes table with a subtle 'override' chip. Click opens a compact modal that lists tenant role vs route override and an action to revert.
ricardo (eng-runtime): Implementation concerns: precedence must be explicit: route override > tenant role > org default. Also affects runtime routing decisions and cache keys — we can't use a single simple policy key if effective role can vary per-route.
mike (sre): Compliance ask: every override must create an audit event (who/when/why) and we should support exportable audit CSVs scoped by tenant/date.
sam (eng-platform): API shape thought: keep tenant roles unchanged and add a dedicated resource for overrides, e.g. POST /tenants/:id/route-overrides. That way we can validate and park pending overrides.
anya (product): UX guardrail: hide per-route overrides under an "Advanced" toggle for non-enterprise tenants. Also show a banner: "Per-route quotas and overrides require Dedicated/Enterprise".
ricardo (eng-runtime): Draft payload for enforcement — simple and explicit:
```
{
  "route": "models/text-embedding-3x",
  "principals": ["team-retail"],
  "role": "embedding-reader",
  "quota": "150000/tokens_month",
  "created_by": "anya"
}
```
This maps to our policy engine. We should run a compatibility check on model cluster / variant availability during creation.
celine (design): UI copy idea: tooltip on effective role — "Applied via Tenant Role" or "Overridden for this route (see diff)" — clicking diff shows previous binding. Also show validation state: pending / applied / failed.
mike (sre): Quota interplay question: if the override grants higher quota than tenant default, should it win? I think default is tenant quota ceiling; allow explicit per-route quota only if the tenant has Dedicated capacity or Enterprise flag.
sam (eng-platform): Agreed. Rule: effective quota = min(tenant_quota, route_quota) unless customer has "allow-route-quota-escalation" flag. UI should clearly indicate when a route's quota is capped by tenant settings.
ricardo (eng-runtime): Edge case: fallback routing. If the overridden route points to a model variant that lives on a restricted cluster, creation should fail validation or return a 202 with validation job. Also, if the override references a model family we later deprecate, we need change notifications to admins.
anya (product): Add a required opt-in checkbox for overrides that change routing ("I understand this may route traffic to different clusters"). For audit and legal.
sam (eng-platform): Operational flow: POST /route-overrides returns 202 + job id. The UI polls /jobs/:id until success/failure. On failure, show error with reasons (cluster capacity, incompatible quantization, missing entitlement).
policy-bot: Audit log: override request created by anya at 1991234567. event_id: ovrd_1991234567_a1
celine (design): I'll produce two mocks: compact table view and modal diff view, including validation spinner states. Will upload to #design-artifacts by EOD.
anya (product): I'll add these to the PRD: API examples, export requirements, legal checklist, and product copy. Tagging @legal for review once PRD is up.
sam (eng-platform): Next steps: ricardo to sketch API + validation job contract; celine mock; anya PRD; mike to draft audit CSV schema. Sync in next platform sync. Closing thread.
